summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The MicroSectors - 3x Short Taiwan ETNs (TPEI) is an exchange-traded product that is based on the VettaFi Taiwan Equity Fund-Tracking index. The fund seeks 3x inverse exposure, reset daily, to the share price performance of an index that tracks the performance of the iShares MSCI Taiwan ETF (Ticker: EWT). TPEI was launched on Aug 19, 2026 and is issued by REX Microsectors.
